speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for seeing me. Please describe your current symptoms in detail, specifically regarding the fatigue, flank pain, and fever you mentioned after your recent antibiotic treatment.

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis. The combination of fever, flank pain, and fatigue following antibiotic treatment for sinusitis strongly suggests an ascending urinary tract infection, potentially due to incomplete treatment or a resistant organism. I will need to confirm this with urinalysis and a urine culture. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis and Urine_Culture.
